items.item:
2. A correction equal to the stored card leaves the revision where it was.
   Shows A03-3. [witness: verification:registry_a03_equal_correction_keeps_revision]
statements:
```text
after correct(p, facts f) accepted:
  editable(p) = f   -- A03-1
  non_editable(p) = non_editable(p before)   -- A03-2
  f = editable(p before) => p = p before   -- A03-3
```

verdicts.why: The check accepts an equal correction and verifies both its returned card and the stored card equal the complete pre-correction card, including the unchanged revision. A differing correction is verified to change the record and advance the revision, showing that the unchanged result depends on equality.
